accepted.title: Two minimal normal measures from local supercompactness
accepted.text: Work in ZFC. A normal measure on κ is a nonprincipal κ-complete ultrafilter U on κ such that every regressive function on a member of U is constant on a member of U. For cardinals κ≤λ, κ is λ-supercompact if there is an elementary embedding j:V→M into a transitive inner model with critical point κ, j(κ)>λ and j[λ]∈M. It is supercompact if this holds for every λ≥κ. If κ is 2^κ-supercompact, must there be at least two distinct normal measures U on κ containing {α<κ:α is not a measurable cardinal}?
accepted.subject: Logic & Foundations
accepted.citation: Question 2.1.1, printed p. 7 / held PDF p. 14.
accepted.scope_review: Exponent 2^κ, not twice κ. Concentration on nonmeasurable cardinals is required for both distinct measures; λ-supercompactness is Definition4.2.18, physical112.
accepted.literature_finding: UA makes the normal-measure Mitchell order linear; consequently every measurable κ has exactly one normal measure concentrating on nonmeasurables (thesis§2.1 and Theorem2.3.11). Thus UA plus a2^κ-supercompact κ supplies a conditional negative instance. The checked results do not establish consistency of that UA/large-cardinal combination; no unconditional ZFC resolution was located.

accepted.title: More than one normal measure on every strongly compact cardinal
accepted.text: Work in ZFC. A normal measure on κ is a nonprincipal κ-complete ultrafilter U on κ such that every regressive function on a member of U is constant on a member of U. Put P_κ(λ)={a⊂λ:|a|<κ}. A fine ultrafilter on this set contains {a:ξ∈a} for every ξ<λ. An uncountable cardinal κ is λ-strongly compact if P_κ(λ) carries a κ-complete fine ultrafilter; κ is strongly compact if this holds for every λ≥κ. Must every strongly compact cardinal κ carry at least two distinct normal measures?

accepted.citation: Question 2.1.2, printed p. 7 / held PDF p. 14.
accepted.scope_review: No concentration restriction and no UA assumption. Distinct from the preceding locally-supercompact target.

accepted.title: The Ultrapower Axiom with an extendible cardinal
accepted.text: Work in ZFC. accepted.title: The local UA inner-model hypothesis above an extendible cardinal
accepted.text: Work in ZFC. A cardinal δ is extendible if for every α>δ there are β and an elementary embedding e:V_α→V_β with critical point δ and e(δ)>α. Work in ZFC. The Ultrapower Axiom (UA) says that any two well-founded ultrapower embeddings jᵢ:V→Mᵢ by countably complete ultrafilters admit internal ultrapower embeddings kᵢ:Mᵢ→N, using ultrafilters belonging to Mᵢ, with k₀∘j₀=k₁∘j₁. Must every extendible cardinal δ admit an inner model N satisfying UA with the δ-cover and δ-approximation properties? Here δ-cover means that for every ordinal θ and A⊂θ of V-size less than δ there is B∈N with A⊂B⊂θ and |B|^V<δ; δ-approximation means that any A⊂θ whose intersections with every B∈N of V-size less than δ belong to N must itself belong to N.
accepted.subject: Logic & Foundations
accepted.citation: Conjecture 8.4.32 (UA Conjecture), printed p. 402 / held PDF p. 409.
accepted.scope_review: Definition8.4.31 physical409 and cover/approximation definitions physical274: the source uses V-small subsets, not an unannounced strengthening to N-small tests. UA is required inside N; it is not assumed in V.
accepted.literature_finding: The current primary determinacy results establish UA in specified HOD models; they do not establish this δ-cover/approximation inner model for every extendible δ in an arbitrary ZFC universe. No exact resolution was located.
